stories.headline: With Weymouth in FA Trophy action, it’s another opportunity for one of Swindon Supermarine or…
stories.body: With Weymouth in FA Trophy action, it’s another opportunity for one of Swindon Supermarine or Dorchester Town to claim top spot from the breakaway group at the top of the table. Second place Swindon Supermarine have played two extra games on Weymouth and Dorchester, and sit level on points with Weymouth, and a point in front of Dorchester.
stories.source_title: Weekend Preview | Second place Winslow United travel to fourth place Biggleswade FC in a big clash in the Division One Central, the A10 Derby returns, and the FA Trophy Round One takes place this weekend
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: Supermarine are away to Hartpury this weekend, with the home side three unbeaten, including an…
stories.body: Supermarine are away to Hartpury this weekend, with the home side three unbeaten, including an impressive 0-2 win away at then-fifth place Westbury United last time out. Meanwhile Dorchester are at home this weekend, and they’ll be hosting bottom of the table Slimbridge at The Avenue Stadium.

stories.headline: Slimbridge haven’t been short on goals despite only picking up one point from their last…
stories.body: Slimbridge haven’t been short on goals despite only picking up one point from their last four fixtures, as they have suffered a 5-4 loss to Shaftesbury and drew 3-3 with Willand Rovers in those games.

stories.headline: The fixture is a chance for Dorchester to make it a whopping 11 wins in…
stories.body: The fixture is a chance for Dorchester to make it a whopping 11 wins in a row in the league. Sat seven points behind the breakaway group, in fourth place are Hungerford Town, who returned to winning ways midweek with a 0-3 win over Slimbridge.

stories.headline: Exmouth currently find themselves 13th after one win in six, and come into this fixture…
stories.body: Exmouth currently find themselves 13th after one win in six, and come into this fixture after a 1-1 draw with Hartpury. Worcester Raiders sit tenth despite being four without a win, and they will look to get back to winning ways against 19th place Barnstaple Town, who picked up their only win in their last seven games in their second most recent match against Willand Rovers, losing last time out 0-3 to Weymouth.

stories.headline: Shaftesbury have seen an up turn in form, winning their last two over Slimbridge and…
stories.body: Shaftesbury have seen an up turn in form, winning their last two over Slimbridge and Bristol Manor Farm, seeing The Rockies move up to 12th in the league. They’ll face a tougher test table-wise with their last two opponents 21st and 22nd, as they host sixth place Westbury United.
